description: This Java class defines a REST endpoint for retrieving application information, using Spring framework annotations and dependency injection. It maps the endpoint '/app/info' to a method that returns application info as a REST resource, handling potential business exceptions.

classes.name: AppInfoRestEndpoint
classes.description: REST controller exposing an endpoint '/app/info' that returns application information as a resource object.

methods.name: getApplicationInformation
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/app/info' URL, calls the application info service, maps the result to a resource, and returns it wrapped in an HTTP ResponseEntity.
